error_reason: The search tool failed to return the visual evidence (image URL) required to identify the landmark on the Vogue cover, forcing subsequent agents to hallucinate the wrong landmark (Eiffel Tower instead of the Rock of Gibraltar).

hypotheses.rationale: The search returned only a text link to the archive page without providing the actual image of the cover. This prevented the Fashion_Vogue_Expert and subsequent agents from visually identifying the landmark, leading the team to hallucinate the Eiffel Tower based on prior knowledge rather than the specific evidence of the August 2021 cover (which actually features the Rock of Gibraltar). Had the image been retrieved, the correct landmark (Rock of Gibraltar) and its height would have been found.
hypotheses.check: Verify that the `perform_web_search` function with the query 'August 2021 Vogue cover' and count=1 is capable of returning an image URL or a direct link to the cover image, not just a text archive link.
